3 . Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the application for grant of bail and submitted that applicant is having criminal antecedents and two more criminal cases are registered against the applicant.
In FSL examination, DNA of applicant is matching with DNA of child who was borne dead to the prosecutrix.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be enlarged on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
6 .
Considering the aforesaid fact that there is positive FSL report which is against the applicant and prosecutrix was minor at the time of incident, therefore, her consent is also not material.
7. Considering the aforesaid circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
8. Applicant is at liberty to file repeat application after examination of prosecutrix in the Court.
